ruling.recommended_action: Refund $1.13 (unexempted detour of 0.80 km × $1.41/km) to the rider as a Ryde voucher under NS-7, and issue a route-deviation advisory to the driver.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 22:57–23:01 with +0.80 km extra (2.19 km driven vs 1.38 km optimal). Driver's congestion claim [F9] is not redeemable under RD-4: no traffic-incident fact exists on the replaced optimal-route segment [F13], and speed-band facts [F10][F11] are only corroborative under RD-4(b)/G3; the AYE band 1 window also ends at 22:57, exactly when the detour begins. No rider consent to the route change before departure (RD-5) — chats [F7][F8] concern pickup only. Not exempt, so RD-2 refund applies to this segment's 0.80 km.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider implicitly seeks the full billed excess of $2.33 for 1.6 km, but RD-2 refunds only Σ(unexempted segment extra_km) × per-km rate = 0.80 × $1.41 = $1.13; the ≤0.25 km-class map-matching residual between the billed excess and the segment sum is not refunded.
Driver's congestion/reroute defence rejected as an RD-4 exemption: no traffic-incident fact on the replaced optimal-route segment [F13]; speed bands [F10][F11] alone do not exempt under RD-4(b).
